svg.title: The private key never crosses the wire
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The private key never crosses the wire” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A laptop holding a 387-byte ed25519 private key and a server holding the 86-byte public key. Three numbered arrows show the server sending a challenge, the laptop signing it, and the server verifying the signature; a fourth arrow labelled 'send the private key' is crossed out in red. Below, known_hosts records the server's own key on a trust-on-first-use basis, and a port-forward runs from localhost:15432 through a bastion to a Postgres on a private subnet, with a direct route from the internet crossed out.
